quote: SkillBridge requests are forwarded to, reviewed, and approved by the first commanding officer or officer in charge (OIC) with Uniform Code of Military Justice authority. This may be further delegated to the field grade CO/OICs with non- judicial punishment authority
fix: Approval is the first CO or OIC with UCMJ authority, delegable to field grade CO/OICs with NJP authority. Remove the LtCol and General Officer tiers.

claim: SkillBridge Marines are reported PTAD (Other) per MARADMIN 280/24 para 3.b
quote: Marines participating in SkillBridge will be accounted for in a S-PTAD status, however, the maximum PTAD limit of 30 days does not apply.
fix: Status is SkillBridge PTAD (S-PTAD) reported in the Unit Status Management Report in MOL. MARADMIN 625/24 also announced a SkillBridge PTAD subcategory.

claim: NCMIS is the SkillBridge system of record and Marines can apply up to 365 days from EAS
quote: Complete at least 180 continuous days on active duty and expect to separate from the Marine Corps within 180 days from the date of commencement.
fix: NAVMC 1700.2B uses NCMIS only for POC reporting and sets a 180 day start window. The 365 day application window is in MARADMIN 280/24 para 4.c and is not repeated.

claim: SkillBridge: Marine keeps pay, BAH and benefits at no cost to Marine or employer, at commander discretion, prioritized for those needing assistance
quote: Marines continue to receive full military pay and station allowances.
fix: Add that Marines may not take compensation from the provider.

claim: TRP is governed by MCO 1700.31 (also lines 14, 42, 335)
quote: 2. Cancellation. MCO 1700.31.
fix: Cite MCO 1700.31A. It cancels 1700.31.

claim: TRP is mandatory: TRS, capstone, ITP, VA benefits briefing
quote: Individualized Initial Counseling (IC), Pre-Separation Counseling Brief, TRS workshops, Capstone Review, and Commander's Verification.
fix: Add Initial Counseling, Pre-Separation Counseling Brief and Commander's Verification to the list.

claim: TRP requires a 12-month lead time for separating Marines (also line 337)
quote: IC: Must be completed not later than 365 days prior to separation.
fix: Say Initial Counseling is due no later than 365 days before separation. Tier I.

claim: DoDI 1322.29 is dated 14 January 2014
quote: DoDI 1322.29 Change 1
fix: Cite DoDI 1322.29 with Change 1.

claim: MCO 1700.30 is Marine Corps Community Services Policy and the authority for career services
quote: MARINE CORPS COMMUNITY SERVICES BUSINESS OPERATIONS MANUAL
fix: 1700.30 is a business operations manual. It is not the program authority for FMEAP, COOL or USMAP.

claim: MyCAA pays up to $4,000, with eligibility by sponsor pay grade

claim: COOL, USMAP and FMEAP program details (cool.osd.mil/usmc, usmap.cnic.navy.mil, DOL registration, no tuition cost)

claim: Schools must enroll on hand-carried records pending the official records
quote: shall enroll and appropriately place the child as quickly as possible based on the information in the unofficial records, pending validation by the official records.
fix: Add that sending schools release official records within 10 work days.

claim: Schools must accept prior course placement
quote: it shall honor placement of a transfer student in courses based on the child's placement or educational assessment in the sending State school.

claim: Schools must continue comparable services under the prior IEP until a new IEP is developed
quote: will initially provide comparable services to a child with disabilities based on his or her current individualized education program (IEP)
fix: Receiving school may reevaluate. Soften until a new IEP is developed.

claim: Children are immediately eligible for extracurricular activities
quote: Flexible qualification and eligibility of children so they can have an equitable chance at participation in extracurricular, academic, athletic, and social activities.
fix: Source says flexible qualification and equal chance, not immediate eligibility. Reword.

claim: The Compact is signed by all 50 states and DC
